title: Multi-omics and experimental validation identify USP54 as a prognostic deubiquitinase promoting pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression within the immune microenvironment.
authors: Yuan, Zibo; Yu, Zhiwei; Xu, Qiuran; Huang, Dongsheng; Cui, Di
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与实验验证研究去泛素化酶USP54在胰腺癌免疫微环境中的预后作用，虽涉及SCENIC转录因子分析，但核心是肿瘤预后与功能实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly lethal malignancy with a complex tumor ecosystem that contributes to its progression. Deubiquitinases (DUBs) are vital regulators in cancer. However, the overall activity of DUBs and their role in driving PDAC progression within immune microenvironment remain largely unknown. METHODS: We employed an integrative multi-omics strategy combining machine learning (ML) on bulk transcriptomic data, single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomic profiling. We applied Coxnet and Fuzzy SVM for prognostic modeling, inferCNV for malignant cell identification, SCENIC for transcription factor regulon analysis, LIANA(+) for inferring inter-cellular communication networks and cell2location for spatial deconvolution. USP54 expression was detected by real-time quantitative PCR, western blotting and immunohistochemistry. USP54 function was validated through in vitro and in vivo assays. RESULTS: ML-based pathway analysis revealed post-translational modification as a major prognostic category, within which elevated DUBs activity emerged as an independent adverse prognostic factor. At the single-cell level, USP54 was upregulated along the trajectory of malignant ductal cells and correlated with an inflamed tumor microenvironment. Cell-cell communication analysis predicted signaling from monocytes/macrophages to tumor cells via the THBS1-integrin ligand-receptor pair. This immune-derived signaling potentially converged on KLF5-positive tumor cells, with KLF5 identified as a putative transcriptional activator of USP54. Spatial transcriptomics validated the co-localization of USP54 expression, elevated DUB activity, and KRAS signaling within specific tumor niches adjacent to THBS1-enriched immune regions. High USP54 expression was frequently observed in PDAC tissues and associated with poor patient survival. More importantly, in both BxPC-3 and PANC-1 cell lines, USP54 knockdown suppressed cell proliferation and metastasis, whereas its overexpression enhanced these malignant phenotypes. Subcutaneous xenograft growth and tail vein injection experiments validated these findings in vivo. CONCLUSIONS: Our comprehensive multi-omics analysis and experimental validation identify the deubiquitinase USP54 as a novel promoter of PDAC progression within a spatially organized tumor-immune microenvironment. These findings suggest USP54 as both a candidate prognostic biomarker and a potential therapeutic target for this lethal malignancy.
abstract_zh: 背景：胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）是一种高度致命的恶性肿瘤，其复杂的肿瘤生态系统促进其进展。去泛素化酶（DUBs）是癌症中的重要调控因子。然而，DUBs的整体活性及其在免疫微环境中驱动PDAC进展的作用仍 largely 未知。方法：我们采用了一种整合多组学策略，结合批量转录组数据的机器学习（ML）、单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组分析。我们应用Coxnet和Fuzzy SVM进行预后建模，inferCNV用于恶性细胞鉴定，SCENIC用于转录因子调控子分析，LIANA(+)用于推断细胞间通讯网络，以及cell2location用于空间去卷积。通过实时定量PCR、western blotting和免疫组织化学检测USP54表达。通过体外和体内实验验证USP54功能。结果：基于ML的通路分析揭示翻译后修饰为主要预后类别，其中DUBs活性升高成为独立的不良预后因素。在单细胞水平上，USP54沿恶性导管细胞轨迹上调，并与炎症性肿瘤微环境相关。细胞间通讯分析预测单核细胞/巨噬细胞通过THBS1-整合素配体-受体对向肿瘤细胞传递信号。这种免疫来源的信号可能汇聚于KLF5阳性肿瘤细胞，其中KLF5被鉴定为USP54的推定转录激活因子。空间转录组学验证了USP54表达、DUB活性升高和KRAS信号在富含THBS1的免疫区域邻近的特定肿瘤微环境中的共定位。USP54高表达在PDAC组织中频繁观察到，并与患者生存不良相关。更重要的是，在BxPC-3和PANC-1细胞系中，USP54敲低抑制细胞增殖和转移，而其过表达增强这些恶性表型。皮下异种移植瘤生长和尾静脉注射实验在体内验证了这些发现。结论：我们的综合多组学分析和实验验证将去泛素化酶USP54鉴定为空间组织化肿瘤-免疫微环境中PDAC进展的新型促进因子。这些发现表明USP54既是候选预后生物标志物，也是这种致命恶性肿瘤的潜在治疗靶点。
